item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Uses `dspy.JSONAdapter(use_native_function_calling=True)`, a signature with `tools: list[dspy.Tool]` and `tool_calls: dspy.ToolCalls`, and an LM stub whose `supports_function_calling` returns `True`."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Inspects `lm.history[-1]` and asserts `entry[\"kwargs\"][\"tools\"]` contains the converted `get_weather` tool definition, proving out-of-band request transport."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Builds `combined_text` from sent messages and asserts `\"get_weather\" not in combined_text`, showing the prompt text omits the tool catalog under native function calling."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Simulates a response with `content=None` and one tool call, then asserts `result.answer is None` and that parsed structured output contains `get_weather` with `{\"city\": \"Paris\"}`."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Uses a local `DummyLM` subclass with a hardcoded tool-call response, so the proof is fully offline with one simulated tool-call response."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
